title: Children of Heaven (bc30)
synopsis: When Ali loses his sister Zahra’s school shoes, this young pair dream up a plan to stay out of trouble: they’ll share his shoes and keep it a secret! But if they’re going to cover their tracks, the kids must carefully watch their step. When Ali discovers a student marathon offering a new pair of shoes as the third-place prize, he seizes the opportunity. In this heartwarming tale of childhood resilience, Ali and Zahra remind us that hope and love blossom even in the face of overwhelming hardship.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 家境貧窮的阿里不小心弄丟妹妹莎拉上學穿的鞋子，為了不被父母發現，這對兄妹想出一個不會受罰的方法：兩人輪流穿著阿里的鞋子上學。他們小心掩飾此事，不讓父母發現，一天卻發現丟失的鞋子出現在同班同學的腳上，但兩人最終因那女孩家境比自己更貧困而放棄了深究。阿里勤力兼職賺錢，希望為妹妹買新鞋子。此時，阿里得知學生馬拉松第三名的獎品居然就是運動跑鞋，他下定決心要成為第三名，贏取禮品。電影以寫實鏡頭記載兄妹間的冒險故事，儘管生活艱難，但未來仍值得小孩勇敢無懼地奔往。

cast: Mohammad Amir Naji, Bahare Seddiqi, Amir Farrokh Hashemian
